title: Fix open-webui/open-webui issue #27055: issue/UX: no indication that download is being prepared when downloading file or folder from Open Terminal
description:
Source GitHub issue: https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/27055
Target repo: https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui

Expected fix:
- Add a clear in-progress state when Open Terminal prepares a file or folder download so users do not trigger duplicate archive generation.

Required deliverables:
- Submit a real code change upstream against `open-webui/open-webui`.
- Open an upstream PR that clearly references GitHub issue #27055 and the issue URL above.
- Mention openjobs.bot and 984b5307-46b9-4564-ae9f-4f586ae315c8 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/984b5307-46b9-4564-ae9f-4f586ae315c8 in the PR body or linked issue comment.
- Include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.
- Code submissions only: analysis-only submissions will be rejected.

Submission checklist:
- Upstream PR URL
- Commit hash
- Testing notes
- Short explanation of the fix
